analysis: LightGCN achieved host-evaluated macro validation HR@10 of 0.5537, exceeding the stated 0.505 reference by 0.0487. Category HR@10 was 0.600 for Movies_and_TV, 0.605 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.335 for Electronics, and 0.675 for CDs_and_Vinyl. This supports collaborative graph modeling as a useful approach, though Electronics remains the weakest category. The result does not isolate the contributions of graph propagation and history pooling. The successful trial consumed 83.03 allocated GPU-seconds.
code_summary: Trains a separate 64-dimensional LightGCN for each category using only training interactions. Two normalized bipartite propagation layers are averaged with the initial embeddings. User representations add half the mean history-item embedding. Training uses single-negative BPR, excludes previously observed items from negatives, and applies embedding regularization with Adam. Checkpoints are selected by validation HR@10, with NDCG@10 breaking ties. Exports materialized user/item embeddings and writes a dataset-routed predictor using the same history-aware scoring.
